ruleset: Standard international (Western) chess — kings, queens, bishops, rooks, knights and pawns; castling, en passant, promotion, checkmate and draw rules. Not Thai chess (Makruk); Thai is only an interface language.

session.note: Wall-clock time from the OpenCode session's creation to the final reproduction-documentation capture. The app, repository, CI, professional docs, reproduction book, ADR log, provenance record and live GitHub Pages deployment were complete at capture time. Documentation-only commits follow the v1.0.0 tag; the tag identifies the app release.

usage.note: Read from the OpenCode session database. totalTokens sums all five counters, including cache reads; cache reads are repeated prompt context and dominate the figure. costUSD is 0 on the flat-rate plan.

verification.method: Node verification suite plus headless Chrome over the DevTools Protocol
